folds.heading: ## Later authorization and current workflow, 2026-11-04 (B88)
folds.body: The parent TECHNOLOGY_AND_PROGRESSION now explicitly records later authorization to prepare all four B5 prompts; CN14’s older write-only-after-acceptance wording no longer blocks their preparation. This packet remains a conditional execution proposal, not an implementation dispatch. Its preceding playable gate is separate from optional human feedback under AD42; current AD36/AD43 proof and AD41’s primary-checkout default supersede blanket human/worktree stops. Retain the actual learned glass → held material → useful vessel consumer, scoped acquired RC2 versus native core stats, real quantities/access and preserved pin/handler meaning. A planner graph, demo receipt or card schema does not execute stock/work or reveal all truth. The old one-realm cap and 1366 target are retired; current world focus, desktop targets, compatibility and live writer ownership govern selected work. No runtime/source acquisition or new model/reviewer/commit is authorized here (AD32).

folds.heading: ## Donor mechanism and source-depth boundaries, 2026-11-04 (B88)
